131.english_meaning: Situated on or going to the open air or exterior of a building.
131.example: The children are playing outside in the park.

131.english_meaning: To give support, confidence, or hope to someone.
131.example: Teachers encourage every child to express their thoughts.

131.english_meaning: To convey or show a thought, feeling, or idea through words or actions.
131.example: Art is a wonderful way to express your feelings.

131.english_meaning: Practical contact with and observation of facts or events.
131.example: Share your experience of watching the night sky with the class.

131.english_meaning: The external form or appearance of something.
131.example: We can see different shapes in the moving clouds.

131.english_meaning: A visible mass of condensed water vapor floating in the atmosphere.
131.example: Dark clouds in the sky indicate that it might rain.

131.english_meaning: To have or use something at the same time as someone else, or to tell others about something.
131.example: Please share your stories with your friends.

132.english_meaning: Preferred before all others of the same kind.
The property possessed by an object of producing different sensations on the eye.
132.example: The Indian flag has three main colours.

132.english_meaning: Devote time and attention to acquiring information on an academic subject.
132.example: I study in a good school.
She goes to school every day.

132.english_meaning: A unit of time equal to 12 months.
A word or set of words by which a person, animal, place, or thing is known.
A question or statement intentionally phrased so as to require ingenuity in ascertaining its answer.
132.example: The teacher asked us some interesting riddles.

132.english_meaning: The large, oval, brown, hard-shelled seed of a tropical palm.
An edible bulb with a pungent taste and smell, composed of several concentric layers.
132.example: My mother cuts an onion for the salad.

132.english_meaning: A thing said, written, or done as a reaction to a question, statement, or situation.
132.example: Write the answers in your notebook.

133.english_meaning: A thing that a person does or takes part in.
133.example: The teacher planned a fun art activity for the students.

133.english_meaning: A covering for all or part of the face, worn for disguise or protection.
133.example: He wore a colorful cat mask for the school play.

133.english_meaning: One side of a sheet of paper in a book or magazine.
133.example: Please open your textbook to page 72.

133.english_meaning: To print something again, especially a book or text.
133.example: The publisher decided to reprint the textbook for the new academic year.

133.english_meaning: A small domesticated carnivorous mammal with soft fur.
133.example: The little cat chased the ball across the floor.

133.english_meaning: Used to identify a specific person or thing close at hand or being indicated.
133.example: This is my favorite book in the library.

133.english_meaning: Intended to help or be used by a particular person or thing.
133.example: This gift is especially for you.

133.english_meaning: Physically touching or forming a surface on.
133.example: The notebook is lying on the desk.

133.english_meaning: An arithmetical value, expressed by a word, symbol, or figure.
133.example: Please write your roll number at the top of the page.

133.english_meaning: A book used for the study of a subject by students.
133.example: Mridang is an English textbook prescribed by NCERT.
